name: miho
description: Agent skills for 9miho — the node canvas where image, asset, reference and video stay connected by provenance. These skills are triggers only: the guidance itself is served by your own 9miho installation over MCP, so it always matches that server's node catalog and spend rules. Requires a running 9miho with miho-mcp configured.
